**Article Details for PMID: 42973333**

**Title:** Clinical and Molecular Outcomes of Dabrafenib/Trametinib-Based Combination Therapy in Acquired BRAF V600E-Mutant NSCLC Following Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor Resistance: A Preliminary Single-Center Retrospective Study.

**Authors:** Dan Xu, Fang Hao, Xia Liu, Xin Wang, Diansheng Zhong

**Journal:** Combinatorial chemistry & high throughput screening
**Publication Date:** 2026-11-03
**DOI:** 10.2174/0113862073425230260817104335

**Abstract:**
Acquired BRAF V600E is an uncommon resistance mechanism after tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy in oncogene-driven non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), and the clinical value of dabrafenib/trametinib-based combination therapy remains unclear. This preliminary single-center retrospective study aimed to describe the clinical, molecular, radiological, and safety outcomes of dabrafenib/trametinib-based combination therapy in patients with acquired BRAF V600E-mutant NSCLC after TKI resistance.
